Chiropractic Care Philippines | Gonstead | Back Pain & Posture

Struggling with back pain, neck pain, or poor posture?

We help patients manage and correct:
• Back and neck pain
• Postural imbalances
• Scoliosis and spinal misalignments
• Work-related and lifestyle-related pain

Spinal Care Chiropractic is the Philippine's first specialized Gonstead clinic providing precise, results-driven care for spine-related conditions.

Watch real cases, chiropractic adjustments, and expert guidance on correcting posture and relieving symptoms safely and effectively.

Our approach emphasizes accuracy, safety, and long-term results—not temporary relief.

📍 Unit 1205, Park Triangle Corporate Plaza North Tower, BGC, Taguig City
📞 +63 917 842 6160

📅 Book your consultation: https://spinal-care-chiropractic-inc.au3.cliniko.com/bookings
🌐 www.spinalcareph.com
